---
title: "Mandelbrot"
output: html_document
date: "2023-05-12"
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

is_mandelbrot= function(c, order = 2){
  z = 0
  for(n in 1:20){
    z = z^order + c
  }
  if(abs(z) > 2){
    return(FALSE)
  }
  else{
    return(TRUE)
  }
}

get_points = function(n, x = c(-2,1), y = c(-1,1), ...){
  res = c(2*n, n)
  xcords = seq(x[1], x[2], length.out = res[1])
  ycords = seq(y[1], y[2], length.out = res[2])
  lista = list()
  count = 1
  for(n in 1:length(xcords)){
    for(k in 1:length(ycords)){
      c = complex(real = xcords[n], imaginary = ycords[k])
      ismandel = is_mandelbrot(c, ...)
      df = data.frame(X = xcords[n],
                      Y = ycords[k],
                      Color = ismandel)
      lista[[count]] = df
      count = count + 1
    }
  }
  df = do.call(rbind, lista)
  return(df)
}

graph_mandelbrot = function(n, ...){
  df = get_points(n, ...)
  print(1)
  plot = ggplot(data = df, aes(x = X, y = Y, fill = Color))+
    geom_tile()+
    scale_fill_grey(start = 1, end = 0)+
    theme_classic()+
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title = element_blank())
  return(plot)
}
```

```{r}
graph_mandelbrot(200, order = 2)
```
